lakefile.toml.text:
name = "NavierStokesAndEuler"
version = "0.1.0"
defaultTargets = ["NavierStokes", "Euler", "ComparatorChallenges"]

[[require]]
name = "mathlib"
scope = "leanprover-community"
git = "https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4.git"
rev = "v4.34.0-rc2"

[[require]]
name = "Comparator"
scope = "leanprover"
git = "https://github.com/leanprover/comparator.git"
rev = "v4.34.0-rc2"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "NavierStokes"
globs = ["NavierStokes", "NavierStokes.+"]

[[lean_lib]]
name = "Euler"
leanOptions = { autoImplicit = false, warningAsError = true }
globs = ["Euler", "Euler.+"]

[[lean_lib]]
name = "ComparatorChallenges"
globs = ["ComparatorChallenges.+"]

sorryExceptions.reason: Intentional independent reference challenge placeholders, not accepted solution proofs. Exemption must require exact path, entire-file hash, line and text match. Never include challenge in solution audit import environment.

Intentional independent reference challenge placeholders, not accepted solution proofs. Exemption must require exact path, entire-file hash, line and text match. Never include challenge in solution audit import environment.

notes: Full repository build includes Euler and four intentional challenge placeholders.
Only actual proof targets may pass axiom audit; sorryAx and Lean.trustCompiler are forbidden.
External tool snapshots are fixed for reproducibility but not yet tested for compatibility. Missing or incompatible tools block execution.
Independent success requires strict real Landlock, enforced AF_UNIX seccomp, nanoda and Lean kernel acceptance.
